pyramiding_rule: Absolute prohibition against pyramiding into losing positions or adding volume during high-volatility price discovery zones.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated multi-timeframe volume-weighted momentum alignment and a confirmed 3-bar consolidation pattern prior to order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Dynamic trailing profit-lock activation starting at +$5.00 with scaled scale-outs to ensure target winners reach the $15-$30+ asymmetry band.
